title: Avoid wasted late source-owner version probes beyond the caller's admission window
outcome: A late-admitted metadata version probe does not hold source-owner capacity past the deadline at which its result must be refused, while issued operations retain Greg's minimum and the approved finite version cap.
acceptance: A controlled-clock regression reaches a version probe issued late in an existing admitted plan and discriminates its actual completion/refusal deadline and source-owner custody; no real-minute wait is added.

Admission or existing owner logic avoids useless late work without shortening an issued call below the existing 60 s minimum, widening other source/request/client windows, refreshing the caller plan or introducing a new resource owner. Any change requiring new timing authority carries Greg's recorded word.
Original success/refusal classification, binary pin and source identity checks remain; review and targeted validation cover the changed production path.
